source_user: A service receives a mix of short prompts and long generations. Design an evaluation plan that reports TTFT, TPOT, throughput, queueing, and P99 latency. Scenario variant 11: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: separate prefill and decode behavior; fix workload distribution; report warmup; use repeated trials; capture GPU memory and request-level traces.
corrected_answer: Assumptions: fix the model and revision, tokenizer, serving engine, hardware, precision, batching/scheduling policy, sampling settings, prompt-length and output-length distributions, arrival-rate/concurrency levels, and correctness/SLO thresholds. Separate prefill from decode. Falsifiable hypothesis: for this fixed workload and warm steady state, configuration B changes paired TTFT, TPOT, throughput, queueing, and P99 latency relative to A while preserving correctness and the agreed P99 SLO; the hypothesis is rejected if its prespecified confidence interval or threshold fails. Run a randomized paired A/B replay using identical requests, randomized order, isolated hosts, warm-up exclusion, and repeated trials at each concurrency/arrival-rate point. Record queue entry, dispatch, prefill start/end, first token, every decode-token timestamp, completion, cancellation, error, retry, and admission event. Report TTFT, TPOT, end-to-end latency, queueing delay, request and token throughput, P50/P95/P99/P99.9, and confidence intervals, stratified by prompt/output length and load. Capture GPU/CPU memory and utilization, batch sizes, power/thermal state, cache/paging, OOMs, evictions, and request traces. Control or record runtime/kernel/model versions, background load, network, and workload mix; check output correctness. Confounders include thermal throttling, host contention, changing batches, cache state, load imbalance, retries, and distribution drift. Roll back configuration B on correctness regression, OOM/admission instability, error-rate increase, or a prespecified P99/SLO breach; retain artifacts and stop criteria. Do not claim causality beyond the controlled comparison.
risks: Tail latency and throughput are highly workload- and scheduler-dependent; uncontrolled batching or arrival patterns can invalidate the comparison.
TTFT, TPOT, and end-to-end P99 can respond differently to prefill/decode contention, retries, paging, or thermal throttling.
evidence_required: Record the exact deployment, workload distribution, load points, warm-up policy, repetitions, timestamps, correctness checks, and resource telemetry.
Use paired confidence intervals and prespecified SLO/rollback thresholds; verify the result on an independent replay.
